_about: ClaudeMail settings shared by every machine. A machine overrides any of them in config/<machine>.json (lower case, e.g. config/stahlwerk.json), which only that machine edits. 'machines' are the folder names under mail/; 'hostnames' maps a hostname that is not simply the machine name onto one of them (the CLAUDE_MAILBOX_MACHINE environment variable overrides both). open_minutes: how long an opened session may take to start before its mail waits for the user; retry_minutes: how often such mail is tried again; expires_minutes: undelivered this long after it arrived, mail is set aside in held/ (the user, 2026-11-06; a sender overrides it with send --expires-minutes). report_minutes: a report is written when what senders rely on changes, else at this interval; stale_minutes: a machine whose newest report is older than this counts as silent (above report_minutes); log_keep_days: older daily logs are deleted at dispatcher start. reports_via: 'files' (the report slots under mail/<Machine>/reports, carried by Resilio) or 'postman' (this machine's Services/Postman spool, carried over Tailscale); no default, and one value for the whole fleet: set it here, not per machine, once every machine runs a postman.
